name: infyicon
title: Infyicon Free Icons
description: Search 161,000+ free hand-drawn vector icons in four matching styles and copy or paste the SVG, PNG or JSX in one keystroke. No account, no API key.
author: infyicon

commands.name: search-icons
commands.title: Search Icons
commands.subtitle: Infyicon
commands.description: Search 161,000+ free icons and copy, paste or download SVG/PNG

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: What Enter does on an icon

preferences.name: defaultStyle
preferences.title: Default Style
preferences.description: Style filter selected when the command opens

preferences.name: pngSize
preferences.title: PNG Size
preferences.description: Size used for Copy PNG URL and Download PNG

tools.name: search-icons
tools.title: Search Icons
tools.description: Search Infyicon's 161,000+ free vector icons by keyword. Returns icon ids, names, styles, page/SVG/PNG URLs and tags. Use before get-icon-svg.

tools.name: get-icon-svg
tools.title: Get Icon SVG
tools.description: Return the ready-to-embed SVG markup for one or more icon ids returned by search-icons.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
